name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys,subprocess
lane=Path.cwd();ex=json.loads(Path('MANIFEST-EXCLUSIONS.json').read_text())['terminal_self_exclusions']; rows=[]
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('TASK.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='c195cecd13d8ab61f2d60dd37dbc01a9cd6f8a39ee1188c8a7a1a47a29a71d90'
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 assert not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
 if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(lane)) not in ex:
  raw=p.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(lane)),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
manifest={'algorithm':'SHA256','scope':'every own-lane file at terminal snapshot, including all completed receipts, helpers, immutable inputs, sources, plans, payloads, search response, guard/search ledgers, figures, reports and frozen-after','self_exclusions':ex,'files':rows}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
for row in rows: assert hashlib.sha256((lane/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(rows),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'all_listed_digests_verified':True,'frozen_after_count':151,'frozen_mismatches':0,'completed_receipts_included':sum(r['path'].endswith('.receipt.json') for r in rows),'terminal_self_exclusions':ex,'scientific_disposition':'HOLD; ordinary unrestricted-v2 negation PASS; no acceptance/credit/formal dispatch','all_calls_synchronous':True}))
